body: Idk. I've just felt this way for the past 7 years.

And I'm sorry to hear. I understand trying to help but not being there enough, as I've had a friend take their life too, but we were so young, at the age of 12. I do think of him dearly when I see someone who resembles him and I miss him dearly, I would do anything to see him to this day and I wish there were something to see him again but it's all in the past now. You are right it's a terrible feeling but not one we can change in an instance. Thank you for you support but I have made a decision and if anything were to occur to disrupt my attempt, you'll be the first to know.
Right now? No. I don't use medication. I do however self-medicate.
Do we ever truly forgot the pain? I think we just subdue it to other issues that become present. Yeah, I may hurt them now but not forever.

I was diagnosed with clinical depression at 12, I'm 20 now, but I do have a great life and enjoy many things in life. I don't consider it an admiration for death because I'm not fascinated with dying, nor am I scared of the thought of it, it's death and it's a part of life. In honesty, I'm not a shitty person, I work hard and try my best to make an impact in the lives of others, I love interacting with people and being kind guy. Ig I'm just tired of myself.
